gt_provenance.details: Dataset batch labels provide GT boxes; predictions are separate.

score_normalization.details: Raw IoU threshold hit counts divided by GT count; no prediction max/min/mean accuracy normalization.

result_existence.details: Three complete logs/configs exist and exact primary numbers match the current report.

dead_code.details: Position evaluator is called and emits last_ position alignment; fused override is live for last_.

scope.details: Three full test sets, one visible seed/main run per dataset; no multi-seed robustness claim.

innovation_boundary.details: SACR/RAPF/QAHNL paper boundary, compatibility-only spatial adapter, no Source-Choice in scoped code/promoted audits.

scope_qualifiers: Nr3D and Sr3D are sequential one-epoch domain adaptations
no per-component causal claim without ablations
